propositions: An optional isolated GitHub Actions adapter must parse coverage percentage from pytest-cov TOTAL line in run-log tail and extract CI-health metadata (status, duration, red-to-green recovery, flake/recheck rates) from run JSON without requiring workflow modifications.

The harvester script must read recent test.yml run logs and metadata via the GH API, process them through the adapter, and persist labeled snapshots to the tracked .rebar/metrics-snapshots.ndjson store (not the gitignored reports/ directory).

The core metrics modules must remain decoupled from the GHA adapter through strict import isolation, with unit tests verifying that src/rebar/metrics/registry.py and src/rebar/metrics/__init__.py do not depend on the github_actions adapter.
Fixture-based unit tests must validate adapter extraction of coverage percentage (e.g., 84.2%) from log text and computation of red-to-green recovery intervals from paired fail/pass run metadata.
